svg.title: Artha deployment, quality and recovery architecture
svg.desc: Production topology across Vercel, Supabase and Gemini with CI, privacy-filtered telemetry and browser-encrypted recovery.

g.text: A small production topology with explicit quality, privacy and restore boundaries
the plaintext bundle never becomes a hosted backup
The browser receives public Supabase configuration only.
No service-role key • no Gemini key • no raw financial analytics payload
